title: NutriEmotion AI Food Reference Starter Catalog
important_limitations: This is a starter reference catalog, not an exhaustive list of all foods.
Nutrition values are approximate generic averages and may differ by recipe, brand, cooking method, and portion.
Images are labeled illustrative SVG cards, not photographs and not suitable as a vision model training dataset.
Use a real vision model to recognize unseen foods; use this catalog to map known names and provide fallback reference data.
Do not claim exact calories or allergen detection from an image.
